name: web-blue-travel-admin-active-users-dashboard
title: Travel Admin Active Users Dashboard
whatItIs: A lavender board with a torn-paper title 'Active User' above a light admin dashboard: sidebar navigation, four coloured KPI cards with sparklines, filter tabs and a user table with status badges and pagination.
whatItMeans: Colour-coded KPI cards with tiny sparklines make numbers scannable, and status pills make table states instantly clear.
techniques: Four KPI cards each with its own tint and sparkline
Status pills in green, red and grey in the table
Blue gradient primary button and sidebar selection
Torn-paper title as a friendly annotation
Avatar and handle in the first table column

vocabulary.definition: A card showing one key metric with a trend.
A tiny line chart without axes.
A coloured rounded label indicating state.
